description_zh: 查询云电脑规格的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktop-types --business-channel example-string --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-type-id ecd.graphics.xlarge --instance-type-family ecd.graphics --cpu-count 2 --memory-size 4096 --gpu-count 1.0 --desktop-id-for-modify ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --order-type DOWNGRADE --applied-scope Public --desktop-group-id-for-modify dg-abcdefg0000 --gpu-driver-type A10 --order-by Memory --sort-type ASC --scope FastBuy --desktop-type-id-list eds.enterprise.4c8g --support-min-session-count 2 --zone-id '无' --gpu-memory 1 --scope-set example-string --office-site-id example-string --desktop-scenario example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktopTypes

parameters.help_en: The BusinessChannel
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions that Elastic Desktop Service supports
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance type.

> If you omit both the `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` parameters, the operation returns all available WUYING Workspace instance types
parameters.help_zh:
规格ID。

> 当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息
parameters.name: desktop_type_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type family.

> If you omit both the `InstanceTypeFamily` and `DesktopTypeId` parameters, the operation returns all available WUYING Workspace instance types
parameters.help_zh:
规格族名称。

> 当`InstanceTypeFamily`和`DesktopTypeId`参数的取值均为空时，将查询云电脑所有规格的信息
parameters.name: instance_type_family

parameters.help_en: The number of vCPUs
parameters.name: cpu_count

parameters.help_en: The memory size, in MiB
parameters.name: memory_size

parameters.help_en: The number of vGPUs
parameters.name: gpu_count

parameters.help_en: The ID of the WUYING Workspace to reconfigure. If you specify this parameter, the response returns only the instance types that are compatible with the specified workspace
parameters.help_zh: 变配时传入需要变配的云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与云电脑之间是否兼容的信息
parameters.name: desktop_id_for_modify

parameters.help_en: The order type
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en: The scope of the instance types to query. Default value: `Public`
parameters.name: applied_scope

parameters.help_en: The ID of the desktop group to reconfigure. If you specify this parameter, the response returns only the instance types that are compatible with the specified group
parameters.help_zh: 变配时传入需要变配的共享型云电脑ID，返回值会增加规格与共享型云电脑之间是否兼容的信息
parameters.name: desktop_group_id_for_modify

parameters.help_en: The GPU driver type
parameters.name: gpu_driver_type

parameters.help_en: The property by which to sort the results. If you omit this parameter, the results are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，若不指定则按照创建时间倒序排列
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the instance types
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: An array of instance type IDs
parameters.name: desktop_type_id_list

parameters.help_en: Filters for instance types that support at least the specified number of concurrent sessions. This parameter applies only to multi-session instance types
parameters.help_zh: 查询规则支持的多会话数量
parameters.name: support_min_session_count

parameters.help_en: > This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: > 该参数未对外开放使用
